name: Ops - OTEL Collector Watchdog
contract_reason: The watchdog was enabled and healthy but unregistered, so cron freshness validation raised enabled_job_missing_contract and enabled_job_missing_expected_artifacts and failed the nightly WF88 P1 chain at step 5. Registering the contract restores drift checking on a local-only supervision route that had none.
description: Bounded local-only OTEL collector supervision. Every 10 min probes 127.0.0.1:4318 and the otelcol.exe PID; if down, starts it detached (loopback-only config unchanged), and alerts after 1 failure. Also alerts when listening but no file-exporter data for 2h. No collector-config, service, scheduled-task, network, external-export, secret/header, capture-depth, finance/canon/capital, or execution authority.
contract_update_reason: Initial registration. Contract records the live job as observed on 2026-09-16 (lastStatus ok, consecutiveErrors 0); it adds no scheduler, config, or runtime mutation and changes no job field.
